guide.verdict: Public app listed in Xero App Store (app review).

composio.note: No Composio-managed OAuth for Xero; create a custom auth config with your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed OAuth app for Xero, so you must register your own OAuth app and supply its client ID and secret in a custom auth config.
reasons: No Composio-managed app exists for Xero
Consent screen shows your brand instead of Composio
Dedicated rate-limit quota instead of shared
Control over scopes and polling intervals

scenarios.label: Public app listed in Xero App Store
scenarios.when_this_applies: You offer the agent to many outside Xero customers and want to be certified and listed in the Xero App Store.

hands_on.basis: Estimate from steps; the assessment typically takes about 5 working days to complete (c8).

waiting.basis: No verified source backs this timeline (the agent's estimate was "5-10 working days for review, longer if remediation is needed").

scenarios.approval: Apply to the Xero App Partner Program, complete certification, pass a security assessment reviewed by Xero's security team, then submit the listing for review. The security assessment repeats every year.
extras: Security assessment must be passed every year.
Not certified or listed until assessments are passed.

modifiers.note: Security assessment must be passed every year.
Not certified or listed until assessments are passed.

prerequisites.title: Own Xero OAuth app credentials
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed app for Xero, so you need your own client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Sign Up with Xero implemented
prerequisites.detail: Implement it before submitting the App Store listing for review.

steps.title: Create your Xero OAuth app
steps.detail: Log in to the Xero developer portal and register the app, using the redirect URI copied from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config for the xero toolkit via Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a test connection succeeds.

steps.title: Implement Sign Up with Xero
steps.detail: Required before submitting the listing. The agent can help draft the implementation plan.
steps.done_when: Sign Up with Xero works in your app.

steps.title: Draft listing and security answers
steps.detail: Prepare listing text and draft security assessment answers covering authentication, encryption, audit logging and personnel security.
steps.done_when: Drafts are ready for your review.

steps.title: Apply to App Partner Program
steps.detail: Submit the application and complete certification with Xero.
steps.done_when: Xero accepts you into the program.

steps.title: Submit assessment and listing
steps.detail: Return the security assessment and submit the listing in the Xero Developer Centre.

steps.title: Wait for Xero review
steps.detail: Xero assesses the answers and emails the result. Expect possible follow-up questions.

traps.title: No managed app for Xero
traps.detail: Composio has no managed OAuth for Xero, so you cannot prototype with Composio's app.

traps.title: Assessment repeats yearly
traps.detail: You must pass the security assessment every year, not just once.

traps.title: Failing adds up to 90 days
traps.detail: After a failed assessment you get 30 days for a remediation plan and 60 days to implement changes, then Xero re-reviews.

traps.title: Advanced assessment at 1,000 connections
traps.detail: Reaching 1,000 or more connections requires an advanced security assessment.

blockers.symptom: Xero says the app did not pass the security assessment
blockers.what_it_means: You must remediate before certification or listing.
blockers.what_to_do: Send a remediation plan within 30 days and implement changes within 60 days.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan from the report.
